theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Dips Don't Mean Permanent Losses
body: Volatility is normal. Panic selling locks in losses. Staying invested through ups and downs helps wealth compound.
caption: Market fluctuations are temporary. Emotional decisions during downturns often hurt long-term goals. Understanding this mindset shift separates successful investors from reactive ones. #BehavioralFinance #InvestmentMindset #VolatilityInsights #LongTermWealth #SmartInvesting
